findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging — Incomplete Principal Logging and No Tamper-Evidence
findings.description: The create_charge handler logs client_id but refund_charge omits client_id from structured logs. No tamper-evidence configuration exists: no CloudTrail with log file validation, no CloudWatch log retention policy, no log group deletion protection.
findings.gap: Inconsistent principal logging across write operations. No tamper-evidence assurance for audit logs (no CloudTrail, no retention policy, no deletion protection).
findings.recommendation: Add client_id to refund_charge log line. Configure CloudTrail with log file validation. Set CloudWatch log retention policy and deletion protection on log groups.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled requires full audit attribution with tamper-evident storage.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: AUTH-Q6 fired because refund_charge handler omits client_id from logs and no tamper-evidence configuration exists in IaC.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add client_id to refund_charge log line in src/payments/handlers.py. Configure CloudWatch log retention policy in infra/template.yaml.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation logs authenticated principal. CloudTrail with log file validation enabled. Log groups have retention policies and deletion protection.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty — No Residency Controls for Financial Data
findings.description: The payments API stores financial transaction data (charges, refunds, amounts) in DynamoDB without explicit data residency configuration or compliance documentation. No mechanism signals to agent consumers that financial data should not be transmitted cross-region.
findings.gap: No data residency controls, documentation, or classification headers. No region-pinning beyond implicit SAM deployment region.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Add residency metadata to API responses. Constrain deployment region explicitly in IaC.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled and financial transaction data has no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q2 fired because the system stores financial records without explicit residency documentation or controls, and an agent could transmit this data to an LLM in another jurisdiction.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document applicable data residency regulations for financial transaction data. Add explicit region constraint to IaC.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Data residency requirements documented, deployment region constrained in IaC, agent-facing responses include data classification metadata.

findings.title: Identity Propagation — No On-Behalf-Of Flow
findings.description: The system authenticates machine clients via client_id from OAuth tokens but cannot distinguish between an agent acting autonomously versus acting on behalf of a specific human user. No token exchange or on-behalf-of flow exists.
findings.gap: No identity propagation for agent-on-behalf-of-user scenarios. All actions attributed to machine client only.
findings.recommendation: Extend the authorizer to support an optional on-behalf-of claim. Log both client_id and delegated user identity.

compensating_controls: Require different Cognito app clients per agent use-case with separate scopes
Include X-On-Behalf-Of header convention in API spec

findings.title: Concurrency Controls — No Conditional Writes
findings.description: The _idempotent_put function uses a get-then-put pattern without DynamoDB conditional expressions. Two concurrent requests with the same idempotency key could both observe no existing record and both execute the write.
findings.gap: No ConditionExpression on put_item calls. No optimistic locking mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(pk)' to put_item calls. Handle ConditionalCheckFailedException as retry.

compensating_controls: Use DynamoDB transactions for atomic multi-item writes

findings.title: Rate Limiting — No Explicit Throttling Configuration
findings.description: The SAM template defines an API Gateway but does not configure explicit throttling settings, usage plans, or per-client rate limits. Only default account-level throttling exists.
findings.gap: No ThrottlingBurstLimit or ThrottlingRateLimit on API stage. No usage plans.
findings.recommendation: Configure API Gateway method settings with explicit throttle limits. Add usage plans for per-client limits.

findings.title: Blast Radius — No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable business-domain transaction limits exist. An agent could issue unlimited refunds or create unlimited charges per hour without any system-enforced cap.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-client_id transaction counters with configurable limits.

compensating_controls: Agent-specific usage plans in API Gateway

findings.title: Draft/Pending State — No Reviewable Intermediate State
findings.description: All write operations execute immediately. create_charge sets status='succeeded' directly. The pending status exists in schema but is never used. No two-step commit pattern.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed writes awaiting human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement optional pending state for agent-initiated charges with a confirm endpoint.

compensating_controls: Implement pending state with confirm endpoint

findings.title: Approval Gates — No Configurable Human Approval
findings.description: All operations execute immediately upon authentication and scope verification. No mechanism to require human approval for high-value charges or bulk refunds.
findings.gap: No operation-level approval configuration. No threshold-based gates.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable amount thresholds that trigger pending state for high-value operations.

compensating_controls: External approval service with Step Functions human task

findings.title: Schema Versioning — No Breaking-Change Detection
findings.description: OpenAPI spec is versioned (1.4.0) with URL path versioning (/v1/). Spec validated in CI. No breaking-change detection tooling (no OpenAPI diff, no Pact).
findings.gap: No automated breaking-change detection in CI.
findings.recommendation: Add oasdiff breaking-change detection to CI pipeline.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance — No Peer Review or Drift Detection
findings.description: IaC present (SAM template). CI runs on push and pull_request. No explicit branch protection rules, required reviewers, or drift detection configuration.
findings.gap: No mandatory peer review for IaC changes. No drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Add branch protection requiring review. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD Contract Testing — No Breaking-Change Detection
findings.description: CI validates OpenAPI spec structure and runs pytest. No consumer-driven contract tests (Pact) and no breaking-change detection comparing spec against previous versions.
findings.gap: No API-breaking-change detection. No consumer contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Integrate oasdiff or Pact into CI pipeline.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging — No Production-Equivalent Staging Environment
findings.description: Tests run against DynamoDB Local stubs. No staging/sandbox environment configuration in IaC. Single-environment SAM template.
findings.gap: No production-equivalent staging for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Add multi-environment SAM configuration with staging stack.

compensating_controls: Deploy staging stack via SAM config-env
Use DynamoDB Local for integration testing

findings.title: Event Emission — No Domain Events for State Changes
findings.description: Custom CloudWatch metrics published (ChargeCreated) but no domain events emitted via SNS, EventBridge, or webhooks for state changes.
findings.gap: No event-driven integration surface for reactive agent patterns.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge events for charge.created and refund.created.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation — No Rate Limit Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented in OpenAPI spec. No rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After) in response code.
findings.gap: Agents have no visibility into rate-limit budget.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits in OpenAPI spec and add rate-limit response headers.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification — No Formal Classification Metadata (B3 Only)
findings.description: Financial transaction data handled. B1 (API scoping): CLEAR — sensitive fields excluded from responses. B2 (Access differentiation): CLEAR — OAuth scopes differentiate access. B3 (Classification metadata): absent — no data classification tags on DynamoDB table.
findings.gap: No formal data classification metadata (B3 only — aspirational).
findings.recommendation: Add data classification tags to LedgerTable in IaC.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: B1 CLEAR (sensitive fields excluded from API responses), B2 CLEAR (OAuth scope differentiation), only B3 absent (formal classification metadata).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 tiered evaluation: API responses properly exclude the tokenized source field, OAuth scopes differentiate read/write access. Only formal classification metadata is missing (aspirational).

b1.reasoning: Charge responses exclude the source field. No sensitive data (PAN, credentials) in API responses.

b2.reasoning: OAuth scopes differentiate payments:read vs payments:write access.

b3.reasoning: No classification tags on DynamoDB table, no field-level sensitivity annotations.

findings.title: Data Quality — No Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring for the payments ledger.
findings.gap: No quality scores or freshness SLAs published.
findings.recommendation: Publish reconciliation success rate as a CloudWatch metric.

findings.title: Data Catalog — No Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer describes the payments ledger schema semantics. DynamoDB schema documented only implicitly in code.
findings.gap: No formal metadata layer for the payments ledger.
findings.recommendation: Document DynamoDB schema patterns or register in Glue Data Catalog.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: REST API documented with OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec. Lambda handlers map to operationIds.

evaluations.title: Machine-Readable API Specification
evaluations.reason: OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec at openapi/payments.yaml, validated in CI.

evaluations.title: Structured Error Responses
evaluations.reason: Consistent Error schema with code, message, correlation_id. 409/422/404 responses defined.

evaluations.title: Idempotent Write Operations
evaluations.reason: All write endpoints require Idempotency-Key header. DynamoDB-backed deduplication with TTL.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All responses are structured JSON (application/json). Schemas define typed objects.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations exceed 30s (Lambda timeout is 15s).

evaluations.title: Machine Identity Authentication
evaluations.reason: OAuth2 client-credentials via Cognito. Lambda authorizer validates tokens. Principal attributed by client_id.

evaluations.title: Scoped Permissions
evaluations.reason: Per-function IAM policies scoped to specific table. OAuth scopes differentiate read/write.

evaluations.title: Action-Level Authorization
evaluations.reason: OAuth scopes enforce action-level auth. Code checks _require_scope for write operations.

evaluations.title: Credential Management
evaluations.reason: No hardcoded credentials. Env vars are non-sensitive config. Cognito handles auth. No .env files.

evaluations.title: Agent Identity Suspension
evaluations.reason: Cognito app clients can be disabled individually without affecting other clients.

evaluations.title: Compensation and Rollback
evaluations.reason: Append-only design. Refunds are first-class compensation for charges. Individual operations are atomic.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: GET /charges/{chargeId} defined in OpenAPI spec for state inspection.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Only dependency is DynamoDB (managed). Boto3 provides automatic retries. Lambda 15s timeout prevents hanging.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and not on critical path.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results (only single-resource GET).

evaluations.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
evaluations.reason: OpenAPI schema with additionalProperties:false, type constraints, minimums, patterns, maxLength. API Gateway validates against spec.

evaluations.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
evaluations.reason: created_at in ISO 8601 format on all responses. Append-only design. Direct DynamoDB reads (no caching layer).

evaluations.title: PII Redaction in Logs
evaluations.reason: Logs contain only correlation_id, client_id, charge_id, reason (enum). No PII logged.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All API fields use clear names: amount, currency, status, created_at, charge_id. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
evaluations.reason: X-Ray tracing active. Structured JSON logs via Powertools Logger. Correlation IDs propagated.

evaluations.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
evaluations.reason: CloudWatch alarms documented: payments-5xx, payments-idempotency-conflict, payments-ddb-throttle.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: Custom CloudWatch metrics: ChargeCreated count. Namespace: Payments.

evaluations.title: Rollback Capability
evaluations.reason: SAM deploy pins versions. Rollback by redeploying prior artifact. Documented in RUNBOOK.

evaluations.title: API Test Coverage
evaluations.reason: 3 tests covering idempotency, conflict detection, scope enforcement. OpenAPI validation in CI.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB SSESpecification: SSEEnabled: true. Point-in-time recovery enabled.

items.summary: Resolve audit logging and data residency blockers. Fix concurrency controls and rate limiting for immediate agent safety.
Address identity propagation, transaction limits, approval gates, and engineering governance for safe pilot expansion.
Add event emission, rate limit documentation, and data classification for improved agent experience.
Add data quality metrics and catalog for long-term agent tooling maturity.

recommended_actions.action: Fix audit logging completeness and tamper-evidence
recommended_actions.rationale: BLOCKER: Incomplete principal logging and no tamper-evidence prevents compliance for write-enabled agent operations.

recommended_actions.action: Document and enforce data residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: BLOCKER: Financial transaction data requires explicit residency controls before agent integration.

recommended_actions.action: Add DynamoDB conditional writes for concurrency safety
recommended_actions.rationale: Race condition in idempotency check could cause duplicate charges under concurrent agent requests.

recommended_actions.action: Configure API Gateway throttling and usage plans
recommended_actions.rationale: No rate limiting leaves the service vulnerable to runaway agent loops at machine speed.

recommended_actions.action: Implement transaction limits and approval gates
recommended_actions.rationale: No business-domain caps on agent operations. High-value transactions should support human review.
Agent tool bindings could break silently when OpenAPI spec changes without detection.
